Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

a.
PC-488-18; Application to remove 2 Canary Island pine trees located in the parkway adjacent to 1609 Via Zurita
Applicant: Yelena and Boris Gelman
1608 Via Zurita
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Recommended approval of PC-488-18 with conditions as follows:
Require the Standard Conditions for tree removal approvals; Require payment of $1,000 to the Tree Bank; Require removal of the stumps; Prior to issuance of any permit for a tree removal, the applicant shall submit a survey to determine the location of the two Canary Island pine trees located adjacent to 1609 Via Zurita; If in the sole determination of the City, the tree trunks are determined to be partially located on private property, the City shall require the applicant to obtain authorization for the tree removals through the Palos Verdes Homes Association pursuant to adopted guidelines and established procedures for implementing the view restoration consistent with the enabling covenants, conditions and restrictions. Issuance of any permit for a tree removal shall be contingent upon any and all requirements of the Palos Verdes Homes Association having been satisfied, including but not limited to any legal proceedings by Alternate Dispute Resolution and a court action. (3-0-2 in favor, Wade and Rubincam absent)

Recommend removal of the smaller Eucalyptus and approval to trim the Silver Dollar Eucalyptus to lower and thin the density to improve the view and maintain the health of the tree. Authorization to remove one tree is according to the 'Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals'. Payment of $500 to the Tree Bank and removal of the stump are required. (3-0-2 in favor, Wade and Rubincam absent).

Introduction on First Reading of Ordinance 18-733, an Ordinance to Amend Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code Amending Title 15 (Building and Construction) Establishing a Requirement of a Homeowners Association Approval as a Precondition to Receiving City Permit Approval
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council introduce upon first reading Ordinance 18-733 adding Section 15.08.160 of Chapter 15.08 of Title 15 to establish requiring applicants for residential and commercial building permits to certify compliance with applicable declarations of covenants, conditions and restrictions (CC&Rs).
Staff Report
